description: This file defines interfaces, proxy/stub classes, and related mechanisms for COM-like object interaction within the WPEFramework, including UnknownStub, UnknownStubType, UnknownProxy, and UnknownProxyType classes, with focus on remote communication and interface querying.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for stub implementations handling interface conversion and message handling.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class extending UnknownStub to handle specific interface and method handlers.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing remote interface references, reference counting, and communication.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template class implementing interface, wrapping UnknownProxy for application use.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of method handlers or stub length.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data pointer to interface pointer.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming messages based on index.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a reference to the interface, possibly creating a proxy.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and handles destruction.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for specific interface by ID.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes proxy or stub operation, possibly deleting object.
